output_list.criticism: The mint function allows anyone to mint tokens, which can lead to token devalue. The mint function is only callable by the preSale address. The preSale address is set in the constructor and can be changed. The mint function should only be callable by the preSale address. The mint function should also check if the totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT. If it exceeds the TOKEN_LIMIT, the function should revert.
